The Las Vegas Strip.name: The Las Vegas Strip
The Las Vegas Strip.description: Resort-corridor spine on Las Vegas Blvd with the metro's densest hospitality and high-rise residential pipeline.

Fremont East & 18b Arts District.name: Fremont East & 18b Arts District
Fremont East & 18b Arts District.description: Downtown revival node east of Fremont Street with adaptive reuse, boutique hospitality, and gallery density.

Paradise & Winchester.name: Paradise & Winchester
Paradise & Winchester.description: Unincorporated township flanking the Strip with mid-rise multifamily and convention-adjacent commercial.

Spring Valley.name: Spring Valley
Spring Valley.description: Established west-side residential grid with steady infill and small-lot redevelopment.

Downtown Las Vegas (Fremont St).name: Downtown Las Vegas (Fremont St)
Downtown Las Vegas (Fremont St).description: Municipal core around Fremont Street with office-to-residential conversions and Zappos-era retail renewal.

Medical District & UMC.name: Medical District & UMC
Medical District & UMC.description: Institutional health corridor anchored by UMC with renovation-led permitting and nearby commercial reuse.

Southeast Las Vegas (Whitney).name: Southeast Las Vegas (Whitney)
Southeast Las Vegas (Whitney).description: Post-war residential belt along the Boulder Highway with teardown/rebuild pressure and indie retail.

West Las Vegas.name: West Las Vegas
West Las Vegas.description: Historic west-side neighborhoods with renovation permits and neighborhood-commercial frontage.

Summerlin South.name: Summerlin South
Summerlin South.description: Master-planned southwest edge with continued buildout phases and high-value residential permits.

Downtown Summerlin.name: Downtown Summerlin
Downtown Summerlin.description: Anchor retail-and-office downtown of the Summerlin master plan under the Red Rock overlay.

Centennial Hills.name: Centennial Hills
Centennial Hills.description: Northwest growth area at the metro's edge with new construction, infrastructure extension, and parcel turnover.

Green Valley.name: Green Valley
Green Valley.description: Mature master-planned Henderson community with renovation-heavy permitting and strict design overlays.

Henderson (Water St).name: Henderson (Water St)
Henderson (Water St).description: Henderson civic core along Water Street with mixed-use infill and ground-floor hospitality.

Anthem & MacDonald Ranch.name: Anthem & MacDonald Ranch
Anthem & MacDonald Ranch.description: Southeast foothill estate stock with teardown-rebuild mansions dominating a low-volume, high-value permit mix.

North Las Vegas (Craig Rd).name: North Las Vegas (Craig Rd)
North Las Vegas (Craig Rd).description: Working-class north-side city with logistics investment, redevelopment, and active parcel sales.

Aliante.name: Aliante
Aliante.description: Master-planned northwest community with new housing, infrastructure extension, and unincorporated county development meeting it.
